[🤤Authentic Nyonya Cuisine in Melaka!👍🏻] 🤯@nenijee_nyonya_kitchen is a restaurant that serves authentic Nyonya cuisine in Melaka! 📜They have over 500 Google reviews with a 4.8-star rating! 👩🏼‍🍳This restaurant was born because of a son who wanted to continue his mother’s Nyonya cooking legacy! 🥓The Ayam Babi Pongteh is made with chicken and pork belly with a balanced salty-sweet flavor! 🥠Their Paitee is totally different from other Nyonya Paitee as they use bamboo charcoal for the outer layer! 🥘Try their Rendang Pork Ribs Buah Keluak which has an umami flavor from the keluak fruit! 🍗Don’t forget to try their other dish too like the Chicken Rendang and Otak-Otak Nyonya! 😍It’s definitely a must-visit spot when in Melaka! [NeniJee's Nyonya Kitchen] @Nenijee's Nyonya Kitchen  ✅Non-halal 📍27, Tingkat Bawah, Jalan Takh 15, Taman Ayer Keroh Heights 1, Ayer Keroh, 75450 Melaka. 📞+6011-1628 8351 #nenijee #nyonya #pongteh #rendang #melaka #fodie #malaysia #malaysiafoodandtravel #mft #foryoupage #fyp
